decision.rationale: I recommend declining this dispute. TXN-008024 posted on 2026-08-18 for 2250 cents on card CRD-000030 at Harbour Brasserie (MER-000074), which is recorded as a RESTAURANT. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-23, 66 days after posting, which is within the 120-day limit. The authorisation AUTH-008221 was approved for 1891 cents. No receipt is attached; the 18.91 EUR in the statement is the cardholder's claim, not a merchant receipt. The posted amount is 359 cents above the authorised amount. 20% of the authorised amount is 378.2 cents, so 359 cents is within the restaurant tip tolerance. Under the restaurant tip rule, a difference within that tolerance is an agreed tip, not an amount mismatch.
